# Retired tsumego ids.
#
# Every id here has attempt rows in tsumego_reports but no SGF in the corpus.
# Their report rows are deliberately KEPT -- removing a problem does not erase
# the attempts people made on it -- so the id must never be handed to a new
# problem. A regenerated position landing on one of these would silently
# inherit a stranger's history.
#
# pipeline/generate_tsumegos.py checks candidate ids against this file as well
# as against the corpus, so a retired id is treated as taken.
#
# Format: one 8-hex id per line. Blank lines and lines beginning with # are
# ignored. Ids are unique across both board sizes, so no size column is needed.
# Append a new block with a comment saying when and why whenever ids are
# retired; never remove a line, and never reuse an id listed here.

# --- retired before 2026-08-02, reason not recorded (28882 ids, 52602 attempt rows)
# Predates the purges below and no map on disk attributes them. Most likely
# the ids retired by the 2026-07-21 id surgery (renames and merges) plus
# problems dropped by earlier corpus revisions. Listed for collision safety;
# the reason is genuinely unknown rather than merely unstated.

# audit its first refuted-move coverage. Two defects:
#   * no refuted first move reaches a double pass at all, so nothing
#     in the file demonstrates the refutation (11 problems);
#   * a move the problem calls losing resolves by exact minimax to a
#     WIN for the solver (2847 problems).
# The SGFs are in tsumegos/broken/9/. Only ids carrying attempt rows
# are listed here; the rest were purged with no history and stay reusable.
